faqs.a: We have 2BHK and 3BHK flats in Zirakpur and Mohali, ready to move.

lead_intro: Happy to help you find the right flat! A couple of quick questions first.

qualifying_questions.question: When are you looking to buy — within 3 months, 6 months, or just exploring?
Which area do you prefer — Zirakpur, Mohali, or either?

qualification_criteria: Qualified if budget is at least 40 lakhs AND timeline is within 6 months AND location is Zirakpur, Mohali, or no preference. Otherwise unqualified.
lead_outro: Thanks! Our property advisor will call you shortly with matching options.
